description: Delete a media for good, so an old or wrong version stops turning up: its file here, proxy, mezzanine and media.analyze results go, and its room comes back to the storage cap. A path import leaves the original in its folder; exports made from it stay. Timelines that use it keep their ids and edits but no longer render (media_offline names it, as for expired media): replace those clips with clip.replace. Importing the same file again makes a new media_id.
